dedupe_keys.name: luas daerah irigasi irrigation area by authority aceh province satu data indonesia

description: This Satu Data Indonesia dataset from Aceh Province presents the area of irrigation schemes (daerah irigasi) in the province, compiled once a year by the provincial irrigation service. The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 (published 7 November 2024, modified 31 December 2024) describes the data as infrastructure data in kilometre units and lists resources on the irrigation area wholly within a district or city by authority and on schemes crossing district boundaries by authority (central, provincial or district), with metadata downloadable as JSON, DCAT/JSON-LD and RDF/XML; a note says the data are still being brought in line with the Satu Data principles. Coverage is Aceh Province. Access is free and marked open; no licence name is given. Caveats: the unit (kilometres) is odd for an area and needs checking against the tables, the page does not show scheme-level names, and it covers one province only. It supports capacity planning of irrigation networks and water demand estimates for Aceh. No related Indonesian irrigation record is catalogued yet; national public works asset data complement it.
